activities.activity: Review SOW, SWMS, drawings and specifications
criteria: Contract scope, exclusions and clarifications confirmed
Current IFC revision of all structural and civil drawings confirmed on Procore
Approved SWMS for formwork, steel fixing, concrete placement
Concrete grades, exposure classes, cover and finish classes taken from drawings / general notes
Inspection notice periods: 24 h notice

Concrete: placing, compaction and finishing method incl. pumping; sequence and times of placement and construction joint locations; hot / cold weather temperature control; sawn joint method, timing and sequence; curing and protection methodology (0314 cl. 3.8: contractor to submit for review)
Reinforcement: type test reports (AS 3600 Table 3.2.1); any proposed change, site bend, splice or mechanical splice
Normal-class or special-class mix submitted for each grade and exposure class on the drawings
Properties as documented: strength grade, slump, max aggregate, cement to AS 3972
Hot-weather retarder / measures nominated so delivered concrete stays within 5-35 C
Surfaces free of loose or flaking scale and rust, oil, grease and mud; stored above ground and protected
CDI free-issue reinforcement (Buildings 2 & 3): condition, tags and quantities checked against schedule within 24 h of delivery; discrepancies notified in writing with photos
Tie wire annealed steel min 1.25 mm
Excavation to RL and dimensions shown; sides stable, base clean, no loose, soft, wet or contaminated material
Founding material inspected and approved by geotechnical / structural engineer at every pad, strip and pit before blinding, membrane or reinforcement (inspection of base / subgrade before covering)
Unsuitable material: stop, notify CDI, Engineer direction obtained

activities.activity: Subgrade / fill under slabs on ground
criteria: Compaction test results for all fill layers passed and closed under the Earthworks ITP
Services trenches by others backfilled and as-constructed received before slab preparation
Position so finished concrete conforms to AS 3600
Plywood to AS 6669, grade to suit loading and finish; forms clean and free of dust and debris before concrete
Release agent applied before reinforcement is placed, thin uniform film, surplus removed
Formwork inspected (cleaned, debris removed)
Bar size, grade, spacing, laps and splices to drawings; position tolerance to AS 3600; cover as documented to AS 3600
Ties at every intersection on beams/footing cages (each stirrup corner; other bars at 1 m max) and at alternate intersections on mats; tie ends bent away from the cover zone
Site bending only to AS 3600, no heat; every projecting starter capped
Reinforcement clean of loose rust, oil, mud and release agent
Checklist completed and issued to CDI 24h before pour; all items closed or accepted
Engineer inspection of reinforcement; KBS supervisor present; all items closed
Concrete booked (grade, volume, truck spacing ), pump, tester and finishers confirmed; access, washout, lighting, evaporation barriers, curing materials on site
HOLD POINT - no concrete ordered for delivery until approved by CDI
Every docket checked and retained: Information plus element placed, water added at plant and maximum permitted on site, delivery supervisor name, placement method
Concrete temperature at discharge between 5 and 35 C; no discharge at ambient below 10 C or above 30 C unless approved heating / cooling measures are in place
Maximum elapsed time from wetting to discharge: 5-24 C = 120 min; 24-27 C = 90 min; 27-30 C = 60 min; 30-35 C = 45 min
NATA-accredited testing; project assessment; slump test on every batch at the point of discharge from the agitator
Compressive strength samples per grade per day spread evenly through the pour
Results kept on site; issued to CDI within 2 business days of receipt; 7 and 28 day results on the Pour Register; low results notified to Engineer immediately
Compaction by vibrators; vibrators not to touch set concrete, reinforcement or embedded items and not used to move concrete
Placing logbook kept on site for every placement: date, grade and source, slump, portion of work, volume
Finish class to drawings; levels and falls to drawings; surface protection
Construction joints only where documented;
Control joints in slabs on ground: tooled or sawn, 3-5 mm wide, depth 0.25-0.33 x slab depth, formed as early as the concrete will take the saw without dislodging aggregate (same day in heat)

Expansion / isolation joints: dowels located and aligned per drawings and held during placement; joint surfaces dry, clean and primed; non-adhering backing rod; filler and sealant as documented, finished flush; watertight where subject to water
Curing continuous from completion of finishing once the surface will not be damaged; method per the submitted and reviewed curing methodology
Formwork stripped before the curing period ends: curing of exposed faces continued within one hour of exposure
Surface finish, edges, joints and rebates conform; defects (honeycombing, cracking, bleed, blowholes, spalls) identified and recorded
Any make-good required before internal walls / modules identified and scheduled
Repair method for any structural defect, and any cutting or coring of hardened concrete, submitted and approved by Engineer before work; proprietary repair materials to manufacturer's data
Defects notified by CDI rectified within 48 hours of notice or as agreed
Repairs recorded with photos before and after
28-day results meet characteristic strength per AS 1379 project assessment; results logged against pour and element
Non-conformance: Engineer notified immediately; NCR raised; investigation (core testing) and disposition per Engineer direction
All pours complete, all defects rectified and NCRs closed
Pour Register and placing logbook complete: every pour cross-referenced to dockets, mix, slump, temperature, cylinders and 7/28 day results
As-constructed information provided (survey responsibility as agreed in the Subcontract)
Founding inspection records, pre- and post-pour ITRs, test reports and this ITP signed and issued to CDI

closing: Works completed and testing completed in line with this ITP except as noted above.
